The [[grunt]]s of the [[Go-Rock Squad]] are underlings introduced in {{vg|Pokémon Ranger}}. They dress in a fashion similar to {{wp|Go-Go dancing|Go-Go dancers}}. The commanders who work at the Night Factory wear white coats, but still keep their glasses.

== Description ==
Grunts are the lowest-ranked members of the [[Go-Rock Squad]] and perform all the group's dirty work. They each possess a [[Super Styler]] to capture and control Pokémon. They use Pokémon of various types, capturing those they find in their path. Some grunts are called "Top-Rank Grunts" and only appear at the Fiore Temple when [[Gordor]] tries to use his [[Power Styler]]. After Gordor's defeat and escape, they continue to operate in Fiore until Gordor returns to tell them to stop, after they steal the [[Manaphy Egg]].

Each class of members are:
* The ordinary grunts, who are male and female;
* The Sinister-Men, who appear in the Rayquaza mission: they are actually grunts disguised in clothes similar to those of Hikers;
* The Top-Rank Grunts, who wear gray outfits and blonde (males) or purple hair (females);
* The commanders, who wear white coats.
